Actioned ASINs — Weekly Performance Dashboard

—

Weeks:
Quick:
Change % = (later − earlier) ÷ earlier · n/a = earlier week was 0 · – = both 0 · ROAS = Paid Sales ÷ Spend. Orders, sales, ROAS: green up, red down; Spend not coloured. CM = Jan 1 – Sep 9 reference. Click ⏷ on any column to filter or sort, like Excel.

Notes

  • Spend, Paid Orders, Paid Sales: Ads report (Sum of Spend, 7 Day Total Orders, 7 Day Total Sales). Total Orders, Total Sales: Total Sales report (Total Order Items, Ordered Product Sales). An ASIN missing from a weekly report counts as 0. Sessions are not included.
  • Avg CM % = simple average of column Q; CM $ = sum of column P, both Jan 1 – Sep 9, 2026. Subtotals: sums for values; ROAS and Ad % of revenue as ratios of the sums; % columns as simple averages; change % from the summed values.
  • Flags: “Paused but spend > 0”; “Spend, $0 paid sales” (for the later / last selected week). Downloads include all filtered rows, not just the page shown.
